motion_summary: Eternal Return Bernice Explosive Bola: rugged blond long-haired hunter, narrow amber eyes with mature face per reference, dark hunting coat and large fur collar, shotgun. R fires a binding bola which wraps, explodes then transfers to next target. No live target needed: visualize three short lasso loops travelling to right, successive binding and compact explosions. 12 poses ready; grasp gun with both hands; lower shoulders and aim; front knee braces; first muzzle kick and steel bola launches; binding rope loop opens beside muzzle; he tracks sight right while first loop tightens; small gold-orange loop burst transfers arc to a second loop; arm re-aim and third looping transfer; last small contained orange burst; recoil recovery; ready. Distinct arms and shoulders animate. Gun not bow. Natural stern eyes, not childlike generic girl's face.
